name: Magnitude-Weighted Polar Inequality
description: Replaces a transparent logical condition with a weighted algebraic inequality $v_1 p_1 + v_2 p_2 > -(|v_1| + |v_2|)$ that appears to depend on continuous or integer magnitudes. This completely hides the Boolean structure, forcing the model to deduce that the variables can only take extreme values and thus the inequality simplifies perfectly to a 2-SAT OR clause.
